products.name: Krita AI
products.note: Open-source digital art; local AI plugins; no cloud dependency; community governance

profile_text.body:
The Krita Foundation is a non-profit, open-source foundation that develops and maintains Krita, a free digital painting and image editing application. The foundation operates under community governance and makes its software freely available, with no cloud dependency required for core functionality.

On the AI side, the foundation offers Krita AI capabilities through local AI plugins that run within the application. Because these plugins operate locally rather than through cloud services, users are not required to connect to external servers to make use of AI-assisted features, which the foundation describes as consistent with its open-source and community-governed approach.

No litigation, patent filings, or SEC records are held for the Krita Foundation in the site's current data.
